high_level_description: The Plaza de la Reina in Valencia with the cathedral's baroque doorway and the tall octagonal Miguelete tower, seen from the square on a bright morning.

style_description.aesthetics: Warm, inviting vintage travel-poster illustration of Valencia, Spain; simple confident shapes, gentle grain, uncluttered composition, no lettering, no signs with words, no captions, no user interface.
style_description.lighting: Bright Mediterranean light with soft warm shadows.
style_description.art_style: Mid-century gouache travel poster with flat layered shapes, visible brush texture and a limited warm palette.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A broad sunny paved square edged with trees and cafe umbrellas beneath a clear sky.

elements.desc: The Miguelete, a tall octagonal Gothic bell tower of pale honey stone.
A curved baroque stone church doorway with columns and sculpted figures beside the tower.
A young woman guide holding a small folded umbrella aloft, turning to speak to visitors.
Cafe tables under cream umbrellas and a few orange trees in planters.
